<issue>Issue Title: [BUG] Structured output is not properly propagated in the graph
Description:
### Checks
- [x] I have updated to the lastest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior

### Strands Version
1.21.0
### Python Version
3.12.11
### Operating System
Linux
### Installation Method
pip
### Steps to Reproduce
In scenarios where a node returns both `text` and `structured_output`
### Expected Behavior
Both `text` and `structured_output` should be forwarded to the next agent as input
### Actual Behavior
Only the text output is propagated
### Additional Context
_No response_
### Possible Solution
The relevant logic is here, where `str()` is called on `AgentResult`:
https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/318573d0618c283f6f16ace1117d5e3d76279568/src/strands/multiagent/graph.py#L1002-L1005
In `AgentResult.__str__`, the `structured_output` is ignored whenever `text` is present:
https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/4ba0b47b6322bc7a8b04763e1a4d8f402e4778db/src/strands/agent/agent_result.py#L37-L57
### Related Issues

</issue>

- The __str__ method of AgentResult can remain for user-readable string representations but should not be relied upon for passing all data necessary for processing.

- The bug relates primarily to _build_node_input method in graph.py (specifically the use of str(result) for building the input).

- The AgentResult.__str__ method also limits propagation due to ignoring structured_output.

- The MultiAgentNodeStopEvent and failure code do not directly relate to the bug since they use NodeResult.
